building_stock: Two returned records file Docklands as inner-city rather than suburban housing (Aus Lock serves it under a `cbd-inner-city-locksmith/docklands` path; The Smart Lock Shop lists it under "Inner Melbourne" beside Melbourne CBD, Southbank and Carlton), and the building types actually named for Docklands are multi-occupancy and commercial — "Docklands schools, health facilities, corporate and commercial customers" wanting "access control systems, digital locks, keyless entry systems, restricted master key systems" — so individual smart-lock jobs here read as retrofits onto an existing door in a managed building (Airtasker Docklands: "replacing our old lock with a new smart lock"; "install the ULTRALOQ keypad on my front door in docklands") with shared basement carparks also in scope (Airtasker Docklands: "Installation of 2 x Parking locks at city location carpark . surface mounted into concrete in parking spots").
council_notes: None identified — no returned record mentions a heritage overlay, owners-corporation or body-corporate rule, or rental-provider obligation; the only tenure signal present is 24h Melbourne Locksmith addressing "homeowner, tenant or a landlord" and re-keying "existing locks when moving in", which is a tenure cue and not a regulation, so a writer must not assert common-property or heritage restrictions for this page.
demographic_skew: The records evidence a mixed owner-occupier / tenant / landlord base with move-in turnover driving lock changes (24h Melbourne Locksmith Docklands: "If you're a homeowner, tenant or a landlord... for your home or investment property. From Changing the Keys of the existing locks when moving in"), tech-confident residents who buy the smart lock online themselves and want install-only labour (Airtasker Docklands: ULTRALOQ keypad "scheduled for deliverry tomorrow from amazon i already bought it just need you to install"), and a large non-residential share — "schools, health facilities, corporate and commercial customers" (Aus Lock) and "home and business owners" (Global Locksmiths Docklands page).
common_concerns: Whether the locksmith will fit a smart lock the customer has already bought online rather than requiring one be purchased from them — the live Airtasker Docklands request is "install the ULTRALOQ keypad on my front door in docklands The lock is scheduled for deliverry tomorrow from amazon i already bought it just need you to install".

Whether a smart lock can simply replace the existing lock on the current door instead of forcing a full hardware or door change — Airtasker Docklands review: "Tony did an excellent job replacing our old lock with a new smart lock"; Gorilla Security Docklands frames it as "replace those locks or upgrade the entire system with a new range of smart locks"; 24h Melbourne Locksmith Docklands offers "repair & installation of all types of traditional Deadlocks & Digital Smart Locks".

Whether the smart lock will tie into the phone-app and remote-access setup the property already runs — Outsmart Solutions Docklands: "Through an app on your phone or tablet, you have 24/7 remote access to CCTV video feeds and full control over smart locks on doors and windows", alongside video doorbells.

Whether a smart lock can coexist with a building's existing access-control and restricted master-key arrangements so managed/shared entry still functions — Aus Lock's Docklands page sells "access control systems, digital locks, keyless entry systems, restricted master key systems" into Docklands schools, health facilities and corporate/commercial buildings.
